principle: Nearest work is learned, credited, and internalized as ORION substrate when useful. ADOPT/ADAPT/COMPOSE never means 'discard because prior art'; it means 'ingest the strongest structure and remove only the donor-owned atom from ORION novelty'.

components.extracted_structure: Explicit scoped revisable claims; evidence pointers; add/update/invalidate; competing environments; minimal-change revision; a persistent structured world/information state; epistemic actions separated from solution mutation.
components.orion_role: K/W/M state is built on explicit revisable information rather than hidden context. Donor mechanics become the retained-state substrate; ORION-specific work begins only at causal necessity/authority over higher-level mutation.

components.extracted_structure: Failure typing, active discriminators, diagnosis-specific controlled replay, intervention outcome feedback, causal effect estimation, anomaly priors, and value-of-information/budget-aware probe selection.
components.orion_role: ORION consumes intervention-supported responsibility evidence; generic attribution, active diagnosis and metareasoning are donor-owned and are not claimed as new.

components.extracted_structure: Apply controlled same-task/trace interventions, identify repairs that causally flip the outcome, and retain inclusion-minimal successful repair sets rather than broad hardening or heuristic retry.
components.orion_role: Counterfactual minimal repair is now incumbent ORION substrate and a strong matched parent. P1 may not claim counterfactual repair minimality itself; the residual must require science-specific state ordering, protected invariants and dependency-impact correctness beyond a successful minimal edit.

components.extracted_structure: Translate a diagnosis into an incident/task-specific valid action space; reject mismatched interventions; spend recovery evidence selectively rather than broadening every failure context.
components.orion_role: Diagnosis-to-action validity is an absorbed layer. P1 V2.2 compares against this strong parent rather than against diagnosis-only or unrestricted repair.

components.extracted_structure: Dependency-aware plans, graph checkpoints, staleness, justification/environment tracking, change-impact analysis, rollback, transitive invalidation and affected-subgraph regeneration.
components.orion_role: Scoped reopening is donor substrate. ORION uses it after a justified mutation; it does not claim transitive invalidation itself as novel.

components.extracted_structure: A missing traceability/verification relation is itself a defect that generates a new verification obligation.
components.orion_role: Mechanic-cell and claim-ledger gaps mechanically create research/verification obligations rather than being treated as optional prose TODOs.

components.extracted_structure: Separate proposal, admission and execution; bind mutation to a certificate/capability, exact action/scope, validity/revocation epoch and live-state digest; revoke stale authority and fail closed on drift.
components.orion_role: ORION adopts mandatory runtime enforcement and revocation for authority already earned elsewhere. The broker/reference monitor enforces authority and never creates it.

components.extracted_structure: Recursive audit and targeted follow-up, structured experimental stages, role specialization, selective escalation, deterministic routine progression and explicit cost accounting.
components.orion_role: These become orchestration patterns around the causal/authority kernel; ranking, debate or role identity remain proposal-level and never grant scientific authority.

components.extracted_structure: Controlled failure injection/success prefixes, stepwise verification, hidden gold, paired task-level evaluation and actionable failure attribution benchmarks.
components.orion_role: These structures define how P1 creates and audits cause-confusable/fresh worlds; evaluation discipline is part of the framework, not merely related-work text.

components.extracted_structure: Persistent hypothesis trees reveal weak high-level reformulation; autonomous-science critiques explicitly identify shifting objectives/world-model gaps.
components.orion_role: The framework stores these as problem constraints and known failure modes; ORION does not claim first identification of the gap.

components.extracted_structure: Relevant but not currently task-isomorphic structures: hidden-target active search, post-hoc dependency graphs, collaboration layers, rewind/resume and executable-state re-anchoring.
components.orion_role: Retained as reopen triggers. A future ORION layer may adopt them only after a frozen discriminator shows they solve an active bottleneck.

components.extracted_structure: Withdrawn source retained only as negative history.
components.orion_role: Never used for a novelty strike, baseline authority or framework claim unless a valid replacement source is independently verified.

engulfment_invariant.coverage: Every one of the 36 merged nearest-work rows appears exactly once in this ledger; post-matrix donors may enter through extra_donors but must still receive an integration component.
engulfment_invariant.adopt_adapt_compose: Every ADOPT/ADAPT/COMPOSE row must map to executable substrate, framework orchestration, evaluation governance, or framework knowledge; it may not disappear into citation-only treatment.
engulfment_invariant.defer: Every DEFER row remains an explicit watchlist/reopen trigger.
engulfment_invariant.reject: Every REJECT row remains negative history and grants no authority.
engulfment_invariant.novelty: Novelty is assessed only after the engulfed framework is treated as the incumbent ORION system. Donor-owned atoms are credited to their sources even when ORION executes them internally.

current_residual_after_engulfment: Beyond causal/inclusion-minimal repair: counterfactual evidence that a high-level scientific K/W/M mutation is necessary at the correct epistemic level, preserves registered sibling/invariant checks, and produces exactly the dependency impact bound to the reopen set after lower-level alternatives are ruled out.
